evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CS-Guard, the first benchmark to systematically evalu- ate guardrails for code generation security.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have been ex- ploited to generate malware, but the effective- ness of guardrails for code generation secu- rity remains unclear.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We find that current guardrails perform poorly against malicious code-generation re- quests: for text-to-code, the average attack success rate (ASR) after jailbreaks reaches about 50% for many guardrails; for code-to- code, average ASR approaches 100% on base LLMs and remains high across many guardrails (14.4% to nearly 100%).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We empiri- cally evaluate 9 guardrails across seven LLMs.
